nodes.label: ZapTI Project
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenant WhatsApp helpdesk platform with monorepo structure

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Four workspaces: apps/api, apps/web, packages/shared, packages/database

nodes.label: apps/api
nodes.rationale: Fastify + Prisma + TypeScript API on port 3000

nodes.label: apps/web
nodes.rationale: Next.js 14 + React 18 + Tailwind frontend on port 3001

nodes.label: packages/shared
nodes.rationale: Shared code: auth, email, notification, utils, constants, validation, config, types

nodes.label: packages/database
nodes.rationale: Prisma schema & migrations - single source of truth for data model

nodes.label: docker-compose.prod.yml
nodes.rationale: Local production deployment with Postgres, Redis, Evolution API, API, Web

nodes.label: Evolution API
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp Business API wrapper on port 8080, webhook to api:3000/webhooks/evolution

nodes.label: Known Issues
nodes.rationale: Two Prisma schemas, CampaignLog relation, missing sendErrorNotification, TypeScript errors, Docker build issues, Evolution API unverified, no GitHub remote

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Service
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 16 on port 5432, database zapti, schemas public (api) and evolution

nodes.label: Redis Service
nodes.rationale: Redis 7 on port 6379 with appendonly persistence

nodes.label: Evolution API Service
nodes.rationale: Evolution API latest image on port 8080, webhook to api:3000/webhooks/evolution, uses postgres schema evolution and redis prefix evolution

nodes.label: API Service
nodes.rationale: Built from apps/api/Dockerfile, port 3000, depends on postgres, redis, evolution

nodes.label: Web Service
nodes.rationale: Built from apps/web/Dockerfile, port 3001, depends on api

nodes.label: zapti-network
nodes.rationale: Bridge network connecting all services

nodes.label: Docker Volumes
nodes.rationale: postgres_data, redis_data, evolution_media, evolution_instances

nodes.label: Auth Routes
nodes.rationale: Login, refresh, logout, me, 2FA enable/verify/disable endpoints under /auth

nodes.label: Tenants Routes
nodes.rationale: CRUD for tenants, SUPER_ADMIN only, includes stats endpoint

nodes.label: Users Routes
nodes.rationale: CRUD for users within tenant, ADMIN+, invite, reset password, resend invite

nodes.label: Contacts Routes
nodes.rationale: CRUD for WhatsApp contacts, import CSV/Excel, tags, conversations

nodes.label: Conversations Routes
nodes.rationale: CRUD for conversations, assign, status changes, close/reopen, messages, read receipts

nodes.label: Messages Routes
nodes.rationale: Global message listing, send outbound, delivery/read status

nodes.label: Tickets Routes
nodes.rationale: Helpdesk tickets CRUD, assign, status, comments

nodes.label: Groups Routes
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp groups CRUD, member management

nodes.label: Campaigns Routes
nodes.rationale: Broadcast campaigns CRUD, send, cancel, logs

nodes.label: Automations Routes
nodes.rationale: Automation rules CRUD, toggle, execution history

nodes.label: Webhooks Routes
nodes.rationale: Evolution webhook receiver at /webhooks/evolution with apikey auth

nodes.label: Integrations Routes
nodes.rationale: External integrations CRUD, test connection

nodes.label: Settings Routes
nodes.rationale: Tenant settings key-value CRUD

nodes.label: Templates Routes
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp Business templates CRUD, submit for Meta approval

nodes.label: Audit Routes
nodes.rationale: Audit logs with filtering by action, entity, user, date range

nodes.label: Health Routes
nodes.rationale: Liveness (/health) and readiness (/ready) with dependency checks

nodes.label: WebSocket Events
nodes.rationale: Real-time events: new:message, update:conversation, new:ticket, update:ticket, notification

nodes.label: Architecture Components
nodes.rationale: Component diagram showing Browser, Web, API, Evolution, Postgres, Redis in Docker network

nodes.label: Inbound Message Flow
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp → Evolution → Webhook → API → processEvolutionWebhook → Contact/Conversation/Message → WebSocket → Frontend

nodes.label: Outbound Message Flow
nodes.rationale: Agent → POST /messages → API → Evolution → WhatsApp → Webhook status update

nodes.label: Prisma Core Entities
nodes.rationale: Tenant, User, Contact, Conversation, Message, Ticket, Group, Campaign, Automation, Integration, Webhook, Setting, AuditLog, Template with tenant isolation

nodes.label: Key Enums
nodes.rationale: UserRole, ConversationStatus, MessageType, MessageDirection, TicketStatus, AutomationTrigger

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: Access token 15min, refresh token 7d, payload includes sub, email, role, tenantId

nodes.label: Middleware Chain
nodes.rationale: helmet → cors → rateLimit → jwt.verify → tenantPlugin → route handler

nodes.label: WebSocket Real-time
nodes.rationale: WS connect with token, subscribe to conversation/ticket rooms, emit real-time events

nodes.label: Evolution API Integration
nodes.rationale: Config in docker-compose, webhook endpoint, event processing for MESSAGES_UPSERT, CONNECTION_UPDATE, QRCODE_UPDATED

nodes.label: Automation Engine
nodes.rationale: Trigger → Conditions → Actions pattern with SEND_MESSAGE, ASSIGN_AGENT, CREATE_TICKET, ADD_TAG, WEBHOOK actions

nodes.label: Critical Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, EVOLUTION_API_URL, EVOLUTION_API_KEY, EVOLUTION_INSTANCE_NAME, CORS_ORIGIN, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL

nodes.label: Health Checks
nodes.rationale: pg_isready, redis-cli ping, wget evolution, wget api/health, Next.js built-in

nodes.label: Security Measures
nodes.rationale: Helmet, CORS, rate limiting, JWT RS256/HS256, bcrypt cost 12, 2FA TOTP, audit log, tenant isolation

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.rationale: Pino logs, health/ready endpoints, Swagger /docs, AuditLog table with oldData/newData

nodes.label: Índice.md
nodes.rationale: Master index of the vault; always kept current with links to all major notes including Visao-Geral, Arquitetura, ADRs, Tarefas, Problemas-e-Solucoes.

nodes.label: PLANO-ACAO.md
nodes.rationale: Immediate action plan based on handoff.md section 6; 7 phases from git commit through GitHub push, with Definition of Done checklist.

nodes.label: Problemas-e-Solucoes.md
nodes.rationale: Debugging log: errors found, root causes, solutions applied; updated each session with status tracking (resolved/investigating/unconfirmed/pending).

nodes.label: PARA-inspired Vault Structure
nodes.rationale: Core organization pattern for the vault: Index/Overview, ADRs, Tracking, Concept notes, Daily/periodic notes with specific naming conventions.

nodes.label: Vault Naming Conventions
nodes.rationale: Defines naming patterns for different note types: PascalCase for index/overview, NNN-kebab-case for ADRs, PascalCase for tracking, kebab-case for concept notes.

nodes.label: Wikilinks Convention
nodes.rationale: Always use Wikilinks for internal linking; relative paths from vault root; section links with #anchor syntax.

nodes.label: Frontmatter Schema
nodes.rationale: Optional but recommended YAML frontmatter with title, tags, aliases, created/updated dates, and status fields.

nodes.label: Core Behaviors for Claude
nodes.rationale: Read first write second, maintain index, track decisions via ADRs, log problems, update tasks, explain before doing.

nodes.label: ADR Template
nodes.rationale: Standard template for Architecture Decision Records with Context, Decision, Alternatives, Consequences, Next Steps, References sections.

nodes.label: Problem/Solution Entry Template
nodes.rationale: Template for logging debugging sessions with problem, symptoms, status, root cause, solution, and next steps.

nodes.label: Task Entry Template
nodes.rationale: Table format for tasks with ID, description, responsible, start date, and status emoji.

nodes.label: Common Workflows
nodes.rationale: Workflows for starting new sessions, adding architectural decisions, logging problems/solutions, updating task status.

nodes.label: Obsidian Plugins Configuration
nodes.rationale: Lists 15 core plugins enabled and 7 community plugins recommended for installation (dataview, templater, tasks, etc.).

nodes.label: Codebase Integration Mapping
nodes.rationale: Maps vault notes to codebase locations: Visao-Geral→CLAUDE.md, Arquitetura→api/index.ts+prisma schema, ADRs→specific files, Tarefas→handoff.md.

nodes.label: Vault-Codebase Sync Protocol
nodes.rationale: Protocol for keeping vault in sync with codebase: update vault on architectural decisions, log problems when debugging, track tasks parallel to handoff.md, reference vault in code comments.

nodes.label: AI Assistance Patterns
nodes.rationale: Patterns for how users should interact with AI for note creation, decision documentation, problem solving, and learning/exploration.

nodes.label: Maintenance Checklist
nodes.rationale: After-session checklist (index current, tasks match reality, ADRs exist, problems logged, links valid) and monthly review tasks.

nodes.label: Anti-Patterns to Avoid
nodes.rationale: Common mistakes: creating notes without linking, duplicating content, skipping ADRs for small decisions, letting Tarefas drift, using folders over links, not updating index.

nodes.label: Learning Resources
nodes.rationale: Patterns to study in this vault: ADR format, problem/solution logging, task board format, architecture documentation, cross-referencing; plus Dataview queries to build.

nodes.label: Quick Reference Commands
nodes.rationale: Bash commands for opening vault in Obsidian, searching content, counting notes, checking broken links.

nodes.label: Fase 1: Git & Commit
nodes.rationale: Immediate phase: check git status, verify .gitignore, add all, commit WIP with vault docs and ADRs.

nodes.label: Fase 2: Unificar Prisma Schema
nodes.rationale: Compare both Prisma schemas, verify CampaignLog, remove apps/api/prisma if duplicate, validate and generate client.

nodes.label: Fase 3: Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Layer-by-layer build: shared → database → api (tsc --noEmit) → web (next build), commit each clean layer.

nodes.label: Fase 4: Docker Build & Up
nodes.rationale: Build custom images, bring up stack, wait for healthchecks, check logs per service.

nodes.label: Fase 5: Validar Evolution API
nodes.rationale: End-to-end validation: check Evolution responds, create instance, get QR code, scan, verify connection, test webhook delivery, verify DB message creation, verify WebSocket.

nodes.label: Fase 6: GitHub Remote + Push
nodes.rationale: Create GitHub repo, add remote, push to origin main.

nodes.label: Fase 7: Commit a Cada Bloco
nodes.rationale: Golden rule: commit after each successful phase with conventional commit types (build, fix, refactor, feat, docs, chore).

nodes.label: Troubleshooting Guide
nodes.rationale: If stuck: read full error, consult Problemas-e-Solucoes.md, check logs, don't stop to ask, document and continue, if >30min document and skip to next independent phase.

nodes.label: Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: 7 criteria: git commit, Prisma unified+validated+client, 4 layers built, docker build success, stack up healthy, Evolution E2E working, GitHub push done, vault updated.

nodes.label: Useful Quick Commands
nodes.rationale: Docker compose ps, restart, down -v, logs -f, exec api sh, prisma studio, curl health/ready, web check.

nodes.label: Problem 1: Request too large (Docker Build)
nodes.rationale: Docker daemon 32MB limit exceeded by monorepo build context; resolved via .dockerignore, daemon.json max-request-size, or isolated build context.

nodes.label: Problem 2: Two Divergent Prisma Schemas
nodes.rationale: Both apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma and packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma exist with potential divergences; investigating which is canonical.

nodes.label: Problem 3: CampaignLog Removed but Referenced
nodes.rationale: Campaign model references CampaignLog[] but CampaignLog model may have been removed from API schema; unconfirmed status.

nodes.label: Problem 4: sendErrorNotification Removed
nodes.rationale: Function removed from packages/shared/src/notification/index.ts; may have broken imports; unconfirmed status.

nodes.label: Problem 5: Edit Failures
nodes.rationale: Some edits failed with 'Error editing file' for wizard page.tsx and api package.json; unconfirmed status.

nodes.label: Problem 6: Rebuilt Code Gaps
nodes.rationale: Project rebuilt from old handoff; routes web calls may not exist in API; investigating API-web contract gaps.

nodes.label: Problem 7: TypeScript Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Dozens of TS diagnostics across files; tsc --noEmit clean not confirmed; layer-by-layer build planned.

nodes.label: Problem 8: Evolution API Unverified
nodes.rationale: Evolution API service in compose but not confirmed healthy, responding, creating instances, generating QR, or delivering webhooks.

nodes.label: Problem 9: GitHub Remote Not Configured
nodes.rationale: Local repository only; no remote configured; pending GitHub repo creation and push.

nodes.label: Problem 10: Port Conflicts
nodes.rationale: Ports 3000/3001/8080/5432/6379 may be in use by other processes; preventive check with netstat.

nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: Context: each request must know user and tenant for data isolation

nodes.label: JWT with TenantId and Role
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: Decision: JWT payload includes sub, email, role, tenantId; middleware resolves tenant; access 15min, refresh 7 days, HS256

nodes.label: JWT Payload Structure
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: JWTPayload interface with sub, email, role (ADMIN|SUPER_ADMIN|AGENT|VIEWER), tenantId

nodes.label: Token Strategy
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: Access token 15min, refresh 7 days, HS256 with 32+ char secret

nodes.label: Middleware Chain
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: Two hooks: JWT verify then tenant resolution (SUPER_ADMIN can override via x-tenant-id header)

nodes.label: Handler Usage Pattern
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: All handlers use request.tenantId for Prisma where clauses

nodes.label: Login Flow
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: POST /auth/login with email, password, optional tenantSlug for SUPER_ADMIN

nodes.label: Super Admin Impersonation
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: SUPER_ADMIN can act as any tenant via x-tenant-id header

nodes.label: Alternatives Considered ADR005
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: Compared JWT (chosen), Redis sessions, x-tenant-id header only, subdomain per tenant

nodes.label: Consequences ADR005
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
nodes.rationale: Positive: stateless, zero round-trip, SUPER_ADMIN flexibility, future Prisma middleware. Negative: token expiry delay, no refresh rotation, tenant change requires re-login, active check per request

nodes.label: Next Steps ADR005
nodes.author: ZapTI Team
